about.title: A workshop built on honest diagnostics
about.subtitle: AUGU SMART ELECTRONIC SERVICE LTD, known locally as Computer Universe, serves homes, shops and offices across Kigali from our bench in Norvege, Karama.
about.storyP1: We started with a bench, a soldering iron and a simple rule: tell the customer what is actually wrong before charging anything. That rule turned into a workshop handling laptops, desktops, printers, office networks and CCTV systems across Nyarugenge and beyond.
about.storyP2: Today we combine repair benches with a training lab where interns work on real hardware. We believe practical skills and honest communication are the only way to build lasting trust in electronics servicing.
about.step1Desc: We inspect and test the device or site before saying a price.
about.step2Desc: You get a clear cost and timeline, and you decide.
about.step3Desc: Work is done in the workshop or on-site, with real parts.
about.step4Desc: We show you what changed and how to keep it working.
about.trust1: Transparent diagnostic reports before opening devices
about.trust2: Genuine replacement parts tested under warranty
about.trust4: Direct WhatsApp line to the technician handling your repair
